title: Design: No locations shows the empty state with no Totals row
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations, so the Location column and the Location chip show.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, in light theme at 100% zoom.
  • Open A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • Open the design picture "Cleared: No locations" (ar-ap-p4-cleared-no-locations-reshot-2026-11-05.png) (attached to this case) beside the browser at 100% zoom; compare the layout, labels and styles, not the names and amounts, which are only examples. Do not use the older attachment of the same picture, "Cleared: No locations" (ar-ap-p4-cleared-no-locations.png): it shows the design before 23 Oct 2026.
custom_steps:
1. In the Location menu, click "Clear selection".
  2. Close the menu.
  3. Widen the browser window to 1536 px and look across the page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • No location is ticked.

Step 2:

  • The menu closes.
  • The chip reads "Location: No locations" with the location pin icon, still in the filter row.
  • The table area shows the column headings without a Location column, then the empty state.
  • No rows and no Totals row.
  • The empty state reads, letter for letter, "No record matches these filters", "Try changing filters to widen your results." and a "Clear all filters" button.

Step 3:

  • Nothing overlaps, is cut off or clipped.
  • The layout is the same as at 1440 px.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 11 (5 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 10 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location), story SV-11538 (Story 8, Report descriptions and layout)

  • S5-R6a: “With no location ticked ("Clear selection" or unticking every row), the report shows no rows: the native empty state (S8-R5) with "Clear all filters", no totals and no Location column. An export from that state downloads nothing and shows "Empty export", "Export didn't yield any results", as on Sales By Customer.”
  • S5-R6: “The chip reads "Location: All locations" when every location is ticked, the location's name when one is ticked (shortened with "..." when long), "Location: N locations" when N are ticked, and "Location: No locations" when none is.”
  • S5-R9: “The chip is shown whenever the report's list (S5-R3) has two or more locations, and always while fewer than all are ticked, so the choice can always be undone.”
  • S8-R5: “While a report loads it shows the native table progress bar. When the filters leave no rows, it shows the native empty state: "No record matches these filters" and "Try changing filters to widen your results.", with a "Clear all filters" button when a customer or vendor, Past due or Location is chosen; that button keeps the as-of date and returns the customer or vendor, Past due and Location to their defaults (every location ticked).”

Not yet checked against a build: the QA build v26.45.2-6a8b89c exists since 10 Nov 2026 and this case has not been run on it yet.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), version of 5 Nov 2026 (1793886208-34e0), read 10 Nov 2026: page 4 "Location filter and Location column" (board Location.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p4-cleared-no-locations-reshot-2026-11-05.png: figure "Cleared: No locations" (This build (after)), board "4. Location filter and Location column", re-shot 23 Oct 2026, design version of 5 Nov 2026

The design's own words:

  • ""Clear selection" leaves no location chosen: the chip reads "Location: No locations" and stays visible, and the table shows the native empty state "No record matches these filters" with "Clear all filters". No Totals row and no Location column. Reshot 2026-10-23 (round 15). S5-R6a, S5-R9." (caption of "Cleared: No locations")

The design version of 5 Nov 2026 replaced the picture "Cleared: No locations" (re-shot 23 Oct 2026): compare with ar-ap-p4-cleared-no-locations-reshot-2026-11-05.png only. This case also still has an older attachment named ar-ap-p4-cleared-no-locations.png: it shows the design before 23 Oct 2026, so do not use it for comparison (TestRail cannot remove it).

Difference from the PRD (DD-03), closed: PRD version 5 said with no location ticked, "the native empty state (S8-R5) with "Clear all filters", no totals and no Location column" (S5-R6a); the design shows "Location: No locations" with a Totals row reading $0.00 and $0.00 under the headings, above the empty state. Chris Ward ruled on 23 Oct 2026 (answer 13): no Totals row, as the PRD says. The design picture was reshot on 23 Oct 2026 (round 15) and published on 5 Nov 2026; its caption now adds "No Totals row and no Location column." This case follows the PRD (S5-R6a, unchanged in version 11). The held design-version case D-78 (C715560) was deleted from TestRail on 26 Oct 2026 with the QA lead's go-ahead (snapshot in v9-pass-2026-10-26/deleted/).

Design note (DR-03): the design shows with one name ticked the chip keeps its prefix: "Location: Staging Lethbri...", "Customer: 10 Trucking", "Customer: Andrews' Truck ...". Closed without a question: No conflict: PRD S5-R6 / S5-R13 say the chip shows "the name" and the chips are "exactly as on Sales By Customer"; the design shows how (prefix kept, shortened with "..."). Cases now say what the picture shows.
